entities.name: Parnajom of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Pharnajom of Iberia (109-90 BC) was a king of Iberia, the fourth in the P'arnavaziani line, known exclusively from the medieval Georgian chronicles.

As a key figure in the region, Pharnajom played a significant role in the political landscape of Iberia, navigating the complexities of royal succession and external influences.

His reign was marked by the ongoing struggle for power between the Iberian monarchy and neighboring forces, including the Roman Empire.

Pharnajom's legacy extends to the modern era, where his name remains a testament to the enduring history of the Iberian kingdom.

'If a king must be a warrior, I would rather be a warrior-king than a king-warrior.' - Pharnajom of Iberia
